notes: members expand to start, start+step, ... repeated count times; values are decimal strings because int64 does not survive a JSON number in every language
blob_base64 is the complete MRB1 blob: 32-byte header followed by the portable Roaring64 body
a conforming SDK builder must emit exactly these bytes for these members

cases.name: empty
cases.comment: no members; the body is the 8-byte high-container count only

cases.name: single_zero
cases.comment: one member

cases.name: single_negative_one
cases.comment: -1 maps to 0xffffffffffffffff, never 0xff

cases.name: signed_boundaries
cases.comment: every signed boundary; pins two's-complement mapping against zero-extension, zigzag and 2^63 bias

cases.name: int8_boundaries
cases.comment: INT8 domain endpoints

cases.name: int16_boundaries
cases.comment: INT16 domain endpoints

cases.name: int32_boundaries
cases.comment: INT32 domain endpoints

cases.name: duplicates
cases.comment: duplicate members collapse; cardinality counts distinct keys

cases.name: unsorted_input
cases.comment: the signed_boundaries set in scrambled order; must produce identical bytes

cases.name: cross_zero
cases.comment: -5..5; unsigned ordering puts the non-negative high container first

cases.name: array_container_small
cases.comment: sparse values inside one 16-bit container

cases.name: array_vs_run_single_run
cases.comment: 4 consecutive values: run size 6 < array size 8, so a 4-element container is a run

cases.name: array_vs_run_two_runs
cases.comment: {0,1,3,4}: run size 10 is not < array size 8, so the same cardinality stays an array

cases.name: array_container_max
cases.comment: 4096 stride-2 values: array is the minimum, and 4096 is the last cardinality that stays an array

cases.name: array_bitmap_boundary_4097
cases.comment: 4097 stride-2 values: one past the array maximum, and runs are worse, so it becomes a bitmap

cases.name: bitmap_container
cases.comment: 5000 stride-2 values: bitmap beats both array and run

cases.name: run_bitmap_tiebreak_run
cases.comment: 2055 runs of 3: run size 8222 < 8224, so this is a run container. An SDK that compares against 8192 instead of the reference's 32-byte-header + 8192 emits a bitmap here and fails.

cases.name: run_bitmap_tiebreak_bitmap
cases.comment: 2056 runs of 3: run size 8226 is not < 8224, so the very next size becomes a bitmap

cases.name: run_container_single
cases.comment: one dense range collapses to a single run; hasRun with 1 container omits the offset table

cases.name: run_two_containers
cases.comment: hasRun with 2 containers still omits the offset table

cases.name: run_three_containers
cases.comment: hasRun with 3 containers still omits the offset table

cases.name: run_four_containers
cases.comment: hasRun with 4 containers reaches noOffsetThreshold and writes the offset table

cases.name: mixed_container_kinds
cases.comment: array, bitmap and run inside one high container

cases.name: full_low_container
cases.comment: all 65536 values of one 16-bit container serialize as a single run

cases.name: negative_dense_range
cases.comment: -1000..-1 lands in high container 0xffffffff as a run

cases.name: multi_high_containers
cases.comment: one member in each of 8 different 2^32 buckets

cases.name: high_container_boundary
cases.comment: values straddling a 2^32 boundary split into two high containers

cases.name: negative_and_positive_mix
cases.comment: mixed signs across several containers

cases.name: sparse_high_and_low
cases.comment: scattered across high containers and 16-bit containers
